newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index up in June 1 week.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index up in June 1 week.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News index of consumer comfort rose two points, to an 11 year high of three, in the week ended June 1 from the prior week.
The survey, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money.
The current poll has a margin error of plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.
Respondents' confidence in the economy remained high. This week's level held steady at six.
Confidence in personal finances rose to 20, while the rating of buying climate rose to -16 from -18 in the prior week.
Regionally, confidence rebounded in the South and in the Midwest, rising five points to one and to 13 from seven, respectively.
A three week rally ended in the Northeast with confidence falling to 0 from four. However In the West confidence rose, to two from 0.
